notes.title: Dungeon Stalkers 1.4 Update Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[p]Hello Stalkers,[/p][p]The 1.4 update brings a host of new content and system improvements designed to add new depth to your adventures. Test your limits against a new dungeon and powerful boss, and perfect your strategy with a complete balance overhaul and new Legendary gear.[/p][p]Based on your valuable feedback, we've also enhanced combat, improved convenience features like the dungeon reconnect system and secure bag save functionality, and, as you've been eagerly awaiting, added controller support to make your Dungeon Stalkers gameplay even smoother. We’ve also included a variety of bug fixes.[/p][p]Here are the detailed notes for the update our dev team has worked so hard on.[/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]Key Update Highlights[/b][/h2][p][/p][list][*][p][b]New Dungeon 'The Catacombs':[/b] A new area filled with fresh threats and rewards awaits.[/p][/*][*][p][b]The Return of the Lord 'Forgotten King':[/b] Challenge the raid boss, 'Forgotten King', who has returned more powerful than ever.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Stalker Balance Adjustments:[/b] All Stalkers' skills and stats have been rebalanced to provide a new combat experience.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Legendary Gear Added:[/b] We’ve added new Legendary gear with powerful effects, offering a wider range of equipment choices. Some of these new Legendary items cannot be crafted and can only be obtained in dungeons.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Core System Additions & Improvements:[/b] Systems like Killcam, Solo Ranking, and a reconnect feature have been added and improved for a more enjoyable and fair gameplay experience.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Controller Support:[/b] Controller support has been added for dungeon gameplay.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]I. In-Game Play[/b][/h2][p][/p][h3][b]1. Combat System[/b][/h3][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Logic Improvements & Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Improved the accuracy of attack hitboxes for more precise strikes.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with some arrow attacks firing at an abnormally high speed.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved logic to allow large monsters to pass through destroyed doors naturally.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where players could abnormally attack through walls.[/p][/*][*][p]Refined the anti-hacking logic to improve accuracy and fix cases where some projectiles' hit detection was ignored.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where an extra arrow was fired when using certain skills under specific conditions.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the 'Heart Chaser' Legendary gear's arrows consuming ammo and attaching to the character's body.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where shooting near a 'Torch' object would not deal damage.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a rare issue where the game would freeze when taking damage from the magnetic field.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed unintended behaviors of some boss monsters, such as 'The Butcher' boss's attacks not dealing damage.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where some Legendary gear effects were applied unintentionally.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an error where other players' rune information was displayed incorrectly during spectating.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]2. Stalkers: Balance Adjustments[/b][/h3][p][/p][list][*][p][b]All Stalkers[/b][/p][list][*][p]Adjusted the stamina cost of blocking to be more efficient than before.[/p][list][*][p]Melee Attack Block Cost: 30 → 27[/p][/*][*][p]Ranged Projectile Block Cost: 40 → 32[/p][/*][*][p]Magic Attack Block Cost: 50 → 35[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]The maximum duration of the Stun status effect has been lowered to 2 seconds.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the ultimate skill requirements for each Stalker's unique traits. [/p][list][*][p]We analyzed combat data during the Early Access period and adjusted the requirements for Stalkers with an excessively high or low ultimate skill dependency, making them more accessible overall.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]All healing skills now have their healing amounts increased based on the caster's Magic Damage and Intelligence stats.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Baran[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Grappling Hook:[/b] Mana Cost 12 → 14[/p][/*][*][p][b]Deep Stab:[/b] Cooldown 6s → 7s, Mana Cost 7 → 10[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Hilda[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Blade Clash:[/b] Cooldown 5s → 6s, Mana Cost 9 → 11[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Nave[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Liberation Rune:[/b] Movement Speed during cast 100% → 80%[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Lian[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Downpour Rune:[/b] Duration 20s → 15s[/p][/*][*][p][b]Rapid Fire:[/b] Damage 100% → 85%, Mana Cost 13 → 16[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Urud[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Explosive Rune:[/b] Duration 20s → 15s[/p][/*][*][p][b]Multi-Shot:[/b] Cooldown 6s → 7s, Mana Cost 11 → 14[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Shinobu[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Lightning Flash:[/b] Cooldown 6s → 8s, Mana Cost 8 → 11[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Clad[/b][/p][list][*][p]Magic Damage of Bludgeon weapons has been increased to align with the new healing formula.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][i]Based on an analysis of combat logs, the value of skills that cause 'Stagger' has proven to be much higher than expected as Stalkers' proficiency increased. We have made adjustments to all skills that cause stagger to balance this. Furthermore, Rien and Urd's damage contribution in team fights and PvE scenarios was unexpectedly high, so we have made slight adjustments to their sustained damage output.[/i][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]3. Stalkers: Bug Fixes & Improvements[/b][/h3][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Rio:[/b] Fixed an issue where damage was not applied when chaining a specific skill after a basic attack, and where right-click attack stacks were not accumulating. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Baran:[/b] Fixed an issue where opponents hit by the 'Grappling Chain' skill would float unnaturally and an issue where the skill would not activate in certain situations. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Clad:[/b] Fixed an issue where he would take abnormal damage from traps during 'Prayer of Healing' and an issue where the healing amount was not applied as intended. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Lian:[/b] Reworked the 'Lotus Blossom' skill logic for more stable performance. [b]Shinobu:[/b] Improved the explosion hitbox of the 'Blast Tag' skill to function as intended. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Urud:[/b] Fixed an issue allowing characters to walk on top of the 'Steel Trap'. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Hilda:[/b] Improved the 'Shield Block' animation for a smoother transition. Fixed an issue where the 'Counter' skill would not deal damage.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Monsters[/b] [b]Balance Adjustments[/b][/p][list][*][p]Increased the time it takes for boss monsters to finalize their attack direction. They will now track their target for a longer period before attacking.[/p][/*][*][p]The elemental resistance values of bosses have been changed.[/p][/*][*][p]Golden Mimics can now appear in locked chests.[/p][/*][*][p]The Ghost's blood-spitting attack will now track Stalkers more effectively.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where some of 'The Butcher's' attacks failed to damage Stalkers.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where some of the Ghost's resistance values were set incorrectly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Ghost was being caught in Urd's traps. (Ghosts don't have feet!)[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]4. New Content & Systems[/b][/h3][p][/p][list][*][p][b]New Dungeon: The Catacombs[/b][/p][list][*][p]A new map, 'The Catacombs', featuring a new layout and new monsters has been added.[/p][/*][*][p]The Catacombs map is available in all game modes.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Map Structure[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44249378/3233925fd8a2726d46c223d35e1cbc7e0f291995.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][list][*][p]In a specific area of The Catacombs map, you can encounter the 'Forgotten King' field boss.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44249378/e81ef131d45fc94e3db946d9088749e3040b5558.gif"][/img][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Dungeon Reconnect System[/b][/p][list][*][p]A system has been added to allow you to reconnect if you are disconnected due to a client crash or network instability during a dungeon run.[/p][/*][*][p]If your Stalker is still alive in the dungeon, you can relaunch the game to see a pop-up. If you choose to reconnect, you can continue playing with that Stalker.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44249378/fcc250c3b3a809b5adc2d894f0dfb91e0159504f.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]If you choose not to reconnect, you will not be able to do so later, and your Stalker will be considered dead.[/p][/*][*][p]You cannot reconnect if your Stalker dies or the dungeon ends while you are disconnected.[/p][/*][*][p]A disconnected Stalker will die instantly without entering a downed state.
[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Secure Bag Save Frequency Shortened[/b][/p][list][*][p]The secure bag now saves more frequently to your player database to prevent item loss during abnormal crashes.[/p][/*][*][p]If you're worried about losing valuable items from a dungeon run, we encourage you to use the secure bag.
[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Magnetic Field Adjustments[/b][/p][list][*][p]The damage from the magnetic field has been adjusted based on its stage.[/p][/*][*][p]Damage taken will increase as the phases progress.[/p][/*][*][p]The related UI will not be displayed in game modes without a magnetic field.
[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]New Witch's Curses[/b][/p][list][*][p]Three new curses with unique effects have been added.[/p][/*][*][p]The effect of the 'Increased Skill Mana Cost' curse has been buffed from 15% → 50%.[/p][/*][*][p]New Witch's Curses[/p][list][*][p][b]Fatigue Recovery[/b] : Stamina recovery rate is increased until the next Witch's Curse.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Time of Evolution[/b] : One stat (STR, DEX, INT, CON, WIS) is randomly increased or decreased upon defeating a monster or player.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Unstable Power[/b] : All of your damage deals an additional -30% to +50% damage. |[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Gamepad Support Added: Dungeon Play[/b][/p][list][*][p]Controller support has been added for dungeon gameplay.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Please disable 'Enable Steam Input' in Steam's controller settings.
[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44249378/28131349802bd46552cce85b8a7482dd00c93c23.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]If you are using Steam Input, please follow these steps to disable it:[/p][list][*][p]Exit the game → From the Dungeon Stalkers page in your Steam Library, click on the [b]Controller Settings[/b] button → Select [b]Disable Steam Input[/b] 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44249378/6ef03957e7a64db32f7bf1de261c1a584cc790f4.png"][/img]→ Relaunch the game.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Currently Confirmed Supported Controllers:[/b][/p][list][*][p]XBOX and XBOX-compatible controllers[/p][/*][*][p]PS DualSense: Requires separate firmware and driver installation, as well as connection settings.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]We plan to add more supported gamepads and controller support for the lobby in the future.
[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Other System Improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Ping:[/b] Now, information about your ally's ping will be displayed when they react, making communication smoother. You can now press 'Confirm' on a party member's ping to show that you have acknowledged it.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44249378/b1933a4bb470d26cf5144d3902a27f069d689217.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]Killcam:[/b] When your character dies, you can now selectively watch the killcam, spectate, or exit the game with the new 'View Killcam' / 'Spectate' / 'Exit' buttons.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Controls:[/b] Fixed an issue where the mouse cursor would move outside the game window.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]5. Dungeon Environment & Items[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][b]New Legendary Gear[/b][/p][list][*][p]Many new Legendary items with powerful and unique effects have been added.[/p][/*][*][p]Some Legendary items now change an existing skill into a new one when equipped, allowing for a wider variety of strategies.[/p][/*][*][p]The following Legendary items can be obtained from boss drops and treasure chests.[/p][/*][*][p]Some items can be crafted with blueprints. New Legendary weapons can also be obtained from the 'Legendary Weapon Selection Box'.[/p][/*][/list][table equalcells="1" colwidth="156,176,373"][tr][th colwidth="156"][p][b]Image[/b][/p][/th][th colwidth="176"][p][b]Item Name[/b][/p][/th][th colwidth="373"][p]Description[/p][/th][/tr][tr][td colwidth="156"][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44249378/078eb6f6d64f184cd6ea464714eda4badc38d8e5.png"][/img][/p][/td][td colwidth="176"][p][b]Flame Lord's Robe[/b][/p][p](Cloth/Armor)[/p][/td][td colwidth="373"][p]Flame elemental attacks are changed to explosive attacks.
[b]※ You can purchase the blueprint from the Apostle of the Witch Merchant.[/b][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="156"][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44249378/06b5c5360b37a78091e9e9474b91b024ad7de852.png"][/img][/p][/td][td colwidth="176"][p][b]Lantern Keeper[/b] 
(Light Armor/Pants)[/p][/td][td colwidth="373"][p]The cooldown of the Lotus Blossom skill is reduced, and the lotus stays in place. The target hit is briefly staggered.
[b]※ You can purchase the blueprint from the Apostle of the Witch Merchant.[/b][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="156"][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44249378/8bc9d924311fcc4ed2dce483cdc6bfa6fccd2f66.png"][/img][/p][/td][td colwidth="176"][p][b]Caliburn[/b]
(Sword/Weapon)[/p][/td][td colwidth="373"][p]The Counter skill is changed to Shield Bash.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="156"][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44249378/75b4adeb28c15c2dd98cd45495d639ce6baad386.png"][/img][/p][/td][td colwidth="176"][p][b]Iron Thorn[/b] (Bow/Weapon)[/p][/td][td colwidth="373"][p]There is a certain chance for an arrow to be automatically reloaded on a critical hit.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="156"][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44249378/c2821cf9923d88bfdca8ad5fe65d87c59688840c.png"][/img][/p][/td][td colwidth="176"][p][b]Slayer[/b]  (Greatsword/Weapon)[/p][/td][td colwidth="373"][p]While casting a skill, your Defense is increased and you cannot be staggered.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="156"][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44249378/11a6cdf961de5b9f2473e227856079fd885ae404.png"][/img][/p][/td][td colwidth="176"][p][b]Vengeance[/b] (Dagger/Weapon)[/p][/td][td colwidth="373"][p]You gain a 3-second stealth effect upon defeating an enemy.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="156"][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44249378/f812d8186be3f8c3506ff5c083ea191395845b8d.png"][/img][/p][/td][td colwidth="176"][p][b]Dragonslayer[/b] (Bludgeon/Weapon)[/p][/td][td colwidth="373"][p]Deals additional damage to armored targets with basic attacks.[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p align="start"] [/p][list][*][p][b]Increased Legendary Item Drop Rate from Raid Bosses and Boss Map Treasure Chests[/b][/p][list][*][p]The legendary item drop rate from raid bosses, which can be encountered through red portals in Competitive (Solo/Trio) mode, has been increased.[/p][/*][*][p]The chance for Legendary items to appear in treasure chests that spawn in boss summoning areas has been increased.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44249378/135ff282649e2d9267b0d147adfa2a4bdd1880b7.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44249378/47838abc0dd848487c0abcecb1b7abf87fda5dd9.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Level (Map) Improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p]A subtle personal light has been added around your character, improving visibility in dark areas and making character visuals more natural. (This light is only visible to you.)

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44249378/b743283787ccd6743266102c4e77c073721b501b.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Optimized the placement of monsters, portals, and treasure chests in 'Prison Dungeon' and the new 'The Catacombs' map.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed terrain issues throughout the maps that could hinder player movement or cause boss monsters to get stuck.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Monsters[/b][/p][list][*][p]The color of 'Goblins' has been changed in Competitive mode.[/p][/*][*][p]'Mimics' can now appear in locked chests.[/p][/*][*][p]A very rare 'Golden Mimic' has been added, which drops higher-grade rewards.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44249378/0a4b27b1b57819beede41597a9aa0f30803ee71c.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]II. Hideout & Out-Game Systems[/b][/h2][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Leaderboard Revamp:[/b] New Solo Ranking has been added for Competitive mode, providing a variety of leaderboards.[/p][list][*][p]The leaderboards are now separated into Prison Dungeon / Competitive Trio / Competitive Solo.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44249378/b99cc8d67ace70bcc618080ae614edfe8cda44c5.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]The Prison Dungeon leaderboards rank your cumulative achievements regardless of game mode:[/p][list][*][p][b]Tycoon:[/b] Total Gold Acquired[/p][/*][*][p][b]Adventure Coin:[/b] Total Adventure Coins Acquired[/p][/*][*][p][b]Stalker Level:[/b] Total sum of all your Stalkers' levels[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Crafting & Trading:[/b] The term 'Craft' used in the shop has been unified to 'Exchange' for consistency.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Items:[/b] Fixed bugs where stackable items would appear to disappear from the storage and where gear durability was displayed incorrectly.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Rune Page:[/b] Improved the rules for changing rune page names and fixed a bug where runes were not leveling up.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Quests:[/b] The 'Guide Quests' for new users have been improved, and an issue where weekly quests were not progressing normally has been fixed. Additionally, convenience features like quest completion notifications have been enhanced.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Shop:[/b] New products have been added, and new costumes that can be purchased with Adventure Coins have been added to the Stalker appearance section.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Season Pass:[/b] Fixed an issue where Season Pass rewards were not updated instantly.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Costumes:[/b] Fixed a sporadic error in the display of owned costumes.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]III. Matching & Convenience Features[/b][/h2][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Matching System:[/b] The matchmaking system has been improved to prioritize matching you with players of similar skill. Additionally, the matchmaking criteria for new players have been relaxed to make it easier for them to adapt to the game.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tutorial:[/b] The tutorial's guidance has been improved, and a dedicated minimap has been added to help new players learn the game more easily.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Event System:[/b] A 'Hot Time System' has been added, providing a bonus benefit where the Legendary gear drop rate is increased at specific times. A new 'New Player Attendance Event' has also been added.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Operations & Community:[/b] An in-game announcement feature has been added.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Optimization & Bug Fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Optimization has been performed to reduce unnecessary load on the title screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed numerous bugs, including an error that prevented players from deleting friends and an issue where the UI would not appear on the first login.
[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]Thank you once again to everyone who enjoys Dungeon Stalkers. We hope you have an even more enjoyable experience with this update.[/p][p]Thank you.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Developer's Note - September Update Preview
notes.notes:
[p]Hello Stalkers! [/p][p]This is SJGO, Head of Development for Dungeon Stalkers.[/p][p align="start"]Today, we'd like to share the details of our first Pre-Season update, scheduled for next week. [/p][p align="start"]We have prepared a variety of new content and in-game improvements, so please refer to the details below.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h3][b]■ New Dungeons & Content[/b][/h3][p align="start"] [/p][list][*][p][b]New Dungeon: Catacombs[/b][/p][list][*][p]The new map, 'Catacombs,' will be introduced in this update!
In this newly added dungeon area, theme-appropriate monsters will constantly be on the lookout for Stalkers.[/p][p] [/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44249378/5df5fdac4546747e740424adf697aad8d77e492d.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44249378/f23f9b4b70982124f85aeb309e7d0099b88fb54e.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44249378/9445081e1c214d3237a8fdeb09e8db552438a98b.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44249378/1e11b3b7b1b001d129026536b2e89eff8ac8cb27.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44249378/8da2cc5962ff43d5b380c2a701f372935f333234.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b]New Raid Boss: Forgotten King[/b][/p][list][*][p]'The Forgotten King' has returned!
After this update, in a hidden tomb within the Catacombs, you will once again face 'The Forgotten King'.
Defeating the Forgotten King will give you a high chance of obtaining powerful items.
[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44249378/59739154f7387aae7c9b4a23efe46e2afc429ed1.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][/*][*][p][b]Raid Boss Battle Rewards Enhanced[/b][/p][list][*][p]The rewards obtainable from defeating raid bosses and within the boss dungeons will be enhanced!
We are preparing better rewards to make conquering boss dungeons more worthwhile, but don't forget that you'll be competing not only with the boss monster but also with all the other Stalkers aiming for the treasure.[/p][p] [/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]New Legendary Equipment & Blueprints Added[/b][/p][list][*][p]New Legendary equipment will be added to bring more strategic diversity.
Legendary equipment modifies the unique skills of Stalkers, allowing for more diverse strategic gameplay different from the existing meta, depending on your loadout.[/p][p] [/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44249378/64c29bf48da43aeb89a6deedd3269b0abed26566.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Leaderboard Revamp: Competitive (Solo) Leaderboard and Other Common Rankings Added[/b][/p][list][*][p]A new leaderboard for Competitive (Solo) will be added.
The 'Escape Artist' (number of dungeon escapes) and 'The Gladiator' (number of player kills) rankings will be added, similar to the Competitive (Trio) mode, and a new boss kill ranking will be added for each mode.
In addition to the existing 'The Richest' (gold ranking) leaderboard, two new rankings will be added separately.[/p][p] [/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44249378/7b3a49c34bfa7a893533cc3675ed35fe81a0acb1.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b]New Witch's Curses Added[/b][/p][list][*][p]Several new Witch's Curses that can change the tide of the game will be added.[/p][p]Please look forward to the patch notes after the update for detailed information on what synergies they create with existing curses and what new variables they bring to the game.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][list][*][p][b]Costumes Purchasable with Adventure Coins Added[/b][/p][list][*][p]In-game costumes that can be purchased with Adventure Coins will be added.[/p][p]This will allow you to purchase some costumes using Adventure Coins acquired from the dungeon.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44249378/ea12fb8442a35243797a5ca19afaffc428415137.gif"][/img][/p][p] [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][/*][*][p][b]New Rare Themed Costumes Added[/b][/p][list][*][p]Nine new Rare Maid and Butler-themed costumes will be added.[/p][p]Themed costumes will continue to be released in various series in the future.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p align="start"] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44249378/7062bfe72fb144a5d9fb8fa29dd8392e7bd5f841.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]■ Game System Improvements[/b][/h3][p align="start"] [/p][list][*][p][b]Reconnect System Added[/b][/p][list][*][p]We will be introducing a system that allows you to re-enter a dungeon if you experience an unexpected game crash.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p notes.title: Early Access Release Schedule Postponement Announcement
notes.notes:
[b]Hello from the Dungeon Stalkers development team.[/b]

First and foremost, thank you to all the Stalkers who have shared their valuable time with Dungeon Stalkers. It means a lot to us that so many of you were willing to spend time playing the game that we helped create. 

We have carefully read and considered all the feedback and constructive criticism provided during the recent beta tests and Gamescom demonstrations.

After reviewing the feedback, we have come to the conclusion that there are two major areas that need addressing. We need to enhance the overall gameplay experience, and work harder to ensure that when the game is played, it is played in a stable gaming environment. 

Dungeon Stalkers have set these two core objectives as our primary goals as we prepare for the Early Access launch.

We will explain the details through the points summarized below.

[h2]1. Enhancing Gameplay[/h2]

We are currently working on four main areas to improve gameplay, detailed as follows:

[b]Strengthening Player Motivation and Maximizing the Fun of Farming[/b]
We believe it is crucial to strengthen the motivation and reasons to keep playing Dungeon Stalkers. We are reviewing various solutions to increase the diversity of items and reinforce gameplay incentives.

We also recognize that the fatigue from farming can accumulate when Stalkers repeatedly enter the prison dungeon without obtaining desirable items. We plan to improve this by ensuring that each dungeon run generates excitement for item farming.

We will enhance the fun of farming not just by creating more items with good stats, but by adjusting the options on equipment to be more useful, as well as adding legendary equipment with interesting abilities.

[b]Refining and Improving Core Systems for Smoother Combat[/b]
We aim to address the difficulties in employing various tactics in some confined areas within dungeons, allowing for more strategic party battles.

We will ensure that character ultimates can be utilized more dynamically in all situations, allowing for more strategic combat flow.

Additionally, we will adjust the balance between ranged and melee characters to facilitate smooth and engaging gameplay.

[b]Improving Character Movements[/b]
Many of you have provided feedback on the need for more intuitive character actions. We will enhance character running animations to provide a more immersive experience and review awkward attack animations for gradual improvements.

[b]Revamping UI/UX and Matchmaking Systems[/b]
We are improving the UI/UX to make the game system more intuitive and user-friendly. Specifically, we are revamping the UI/UX to make preparation for dungeon entry more convenient and intuitive.

Moreover, we will enhance the matchmaking system to help new Stalkers get accustomed to the game and ensure that experienced players can enjoy more intense and exciting gameplay.

[h2]2. Providing a Stable Gameplay Environment[/h2]

We have identified most of the causes of server instability, such as party matching failures, dungeon entry issues, and in-game delays from the last test. We are working on measures to provide a stable gameplay environment. Once again, we sincerely apologize for the server issues that caused inconvenience during the previous test period.

We are committed to providing a more seamless and stable gaming experience upon Early Access release, ensuring that similar issues do not occur.

Additionally, we are preparing to address several internal issues, including game mode adjustments..


In order for us to implement these changes and deliver a better experience, we have made the difficult decision to postpone the Early Access launch, originally planned for this fall. Dungeon Stalkers is scheduled to launch Early Access in the early part of 2025, after we implement these larger scaled improvements. 
 
We fully understand how disappointing this news might be for those who were eagerly awaiting the game this year, and we acknowledge the frustration of extending the wait. We share your eagerness to bring Dungeon Stalkers to you as soon as possible, but we ask for your patience and understanding as we strive to create a game that will stand the test of time.

The Dungeon Stalkers team is committed to responding to your continuous interest and affection, and we will do our utmost to meet your expectations.

We will continuously share more detailed information about each improvement through developer notes and community updates to keep you informed and engaged.

Thank you.

Sincerely,
Dungeon Stalkers Development Team

notes.title: Developer's Note: June Update
notes.notes:
Hello, Stalkers!
First and foremost, we want to extend our sincere gratitude to everyone who participated in the surprise test last month.

While there are countless tasks to tackle, we'd like to share some of the key areas we are prioritizing and our plans for the future.

[h2][b]Validation and testing of the 
major improvement tasks from the May surprise test:[/b][/h2]

We received a diverse array of feedback on the content added during this test, exceeding our expectations. Once again, thank you for your valuable feedback.

[olist]
[*] New Player Character Summoner Rene
[*] New PvP mode Supremacy
[*] Equipment Stat Rerolling / Equipment Crafting Feature
[*] Daily Quests
[*] Addition of New Equipment slots such as necklace, ring, etc.
[*] Lobby Customization
[*] Addition of Cool Dances
[*] Improved Attack Speed
[*] Increased Frequency of Crimson Veil and Witch's Curse occurrences
[*] Changed to Allow Equipping New Armor even if the current one is destroyed
[*] Changed to allow random matchmaking for one player in 2-player parties
[*] Improvements to ranking leaderboards, etc.
[/olist]
We are currently in the process of implementing improvements based on the feedback received on the aforementioned topics. Additionally, we anticipate that you may be curious about the areas we are aiming to improve in the future.

[h2][b]Areas we are preparing to 
improve quickly after the May surprise test:[/b][/h2]
[olist]
[*] Adjusting Equipment Drop Rates
During the recent test, many players felt that the drop rate for good equipment in dungeons was too high, reducing the need for other content like crafting. We deeply understand this concern and plan to balance it so that dungeons and crafting content can coexist appropriately.

[*] New PvP Mode: Supremacy
Supremacy was the biggest addition during this test. It is still in the development stage, but it was the core content of the test. We wanted to collect and incorporate your feedback from the development stage, all the way through to the completion of the mode. Although there were some server stability issues during the test, we aim to have them ironed out in time for the next test so that we can test the fun factor and balance of the mode. 

[*] Balancing New Content and Features
There were various opinions regarding the balance of newly added features. For example, there was considerable feedback regarding adjustments to the gold cost for equipment re-rolling. We are currently working on balancing these finer details. The equipment swapping system was well received by many Stalkers, and we plan to finalize improvements to it. Additionally, we plan to implement unique attributes for each type of armor in the future.

[*] Improving Non-Intuitive Monster Patterns and Adjusting Difficulty of Some Monsters
We will adjust the balance of certain monsters like gargoyles, which received a lot of feedback regarding PVE difficulty.

[*] Expanding the Use of Acquired Resources
While playing the game, players acquire various resources. Instead of solely focusing on the goal of acquisition, we aim to constantly consider and expand the range of possibilities for how these resources can be utilized. Although this is a long-term endeavor, we plan to reflect ways to utilize leftover resources in the next test as well.

[*] Other Convenience Features and Design Improvements
We also aim to implement some convenience features and design improvements that can be quickly applied. While some improvements may require time for development, we intend to swiftly apply changes to items that received a lot of feedback. For example, a quick sort function for stash and bags and enhancing the visibility of buff and debuff icons. Additionally, there was considerable feedback regarding a training mode, which was already part of the development plan, so we aim to consider its implementation as early as the next test.

[*] Balance Adjustments and Improvements for New and Existing Characters
We will make adjustments based on feedback about the balance of the new character Rene and other Stalkers. Rene has received a lot of feedback regarding unclear hit detection and the ambiguous use of ice summons. She is a character intended to excel at PvE. We will focus on making hunting more enjoyable, and pay more attention to increasing her utility in PvP.

[*] Improving Character Animations and Hitboxes
Feedback regarding animations and hitboxes for certain characters has been noted, and we intend to make improvements based on the feedback provided for the next test. The development team will pay more attention and effort to elevate the overall quality.

[*] Game Optimization 
Game optimization is a significant task, and we are considering and applying various different methods to ensure that you can enjoy the game in the best possible way. 

[*] Other Improvements
We are gradually preparing to implement more improvements to other convenience features as well. We fully empathize with the need for a key binding system, based on the feedback from the last test, and we are currently working on its implementation. However, we feel that there are some areas that need further refinement before being fully integrated into the game for this test. Therefore, we plan to take some more time to ensure a stable introduction within the game. Additionally, we are carefully considering the implementation of other convenience features such as spectator mode and reporting functionality for disruptive users.
[/olist]
Finally, emote features, such as dances, were more well-received than anticipated. We are gradually preparing to introduce a variety of new emotes. We are also considering implementing unique emotes for each character.

Certainly, there are many details that are difficult to convey in a brief message, but many aspects will undergo changes in the upcoming tests.


[h2][b]Plans for the Next Test:[/b][/h2]
The upcoming test will be on a larger scale than the recent surprise test we conducted. Based on the feedback you provided, we will quickly improve what we can, address any shortcomings, and thoroughly prepare for the next test.

In addition to the 7 Stalkers previously introduced, we are preparing to unveil new Stalkers with various charms. We are also in the process of developing new maps with exciting environments to provide even more exhilarating gameplay. Furthermore, we are preparing new Witch's Curses and items to heighten the tension in the game, so please stay tuned.

We are also planning promotions through various media channels. We believe the next test will allow more Stalkers to experience what the dungeon has to offer. 

While the downtime between tests can be dull, we’re preparing various lore dives and stories for you to enjoy. 

Once again, we extend our deepest gratitude to all the Stalkers who participated in the test. Please continue to show interest and support for Dungeon Stalkers. We will work even harder to meet your expectations.

Stay healthy, and we look forward to seeing you in better form in the next test.

Thank you.
David

 ―

notes.title: Dungeon Stalkers 2nd Test added content & changes
notes.notes:
Hello Stalkers!

The 2nd test of Dungeon Stalkers is about to begin! Those who participated in the 1st test have been eagerly wondering what changes will occur in the 2nd test. Numerous balances have been significantly altered, and many improvements based on your feedback have been implemented. Please check the list below!

[h1]Content Additions:[/h1]
[list]
[*] [h3]Solo Mode[/h3] Solo mode, accessible only for solo players and not parties, has been added. Even those playing alone can enjoy the game.
[*] [h3]Rank System[/h3] The rank system has been implemented for the first time. It displays your adventures in ranks. Climb up to the highest rank!
[*] [h3]Stalkers Costumes[/h3] Stalkers' costumes have been added. Initially, you can explore costumes with various color variations.
[*] [h3]Map Block - Goblin Mine[/h3] A Goblin Mine block is added to DS's random maps. The minerals from the Goblin Mine will be crucial items for future crafting. (Crafting is not included in this test)
[*] [h3]Witch's Curse[/h3] Five new witch's curses have been added. (We’ll keep the specifics secret for you to have fun.)
[*] [h3]Witch's Summons System[/h3] To make the time spent in the dungeon's last phase more enjoyable, the Witch's Summons have been added. During the final stage, when there aren’t many monsters or other players wandering in the dungeon, the Witch's Summons will make it more exciting. The Red Curtain (Forcefield) gathers everyone in the dungeon to impose a trial. If you survive the trial, you'll get a chance to escape. But be cautious; not everyone who gathers are allies.
[*] [h3]Ping System[/h3] The basics of ping system has been implemented. You can use ping through the middle mouse button.
[*] [h3]Location-Based Voice Chat[/h3] Voice chat has been implemented, based on location. Your voice can be heard not only by party members but also by nearby enemies in the dungeon.
[*] [h3]Stamina Introduction[/h3] The stamina system has been introduced. By pressing the Shift key, you can sprint for a short period. Unlike the 1st test where MP was consumed upon successful defense, stamina is consumed this time around.
[*] [h3]Various Monsters[/h3] With the addition of the Goblin Mine, various goblins and some other monsters have been added. Some existing monsters have also been modified to have more powerful attacks.
[*] [h3]Friend System[/h3] The friend system has been added. You can add friends or invite them to parties from the 'Dungeon' menu by clicking the friend icon.
[*] [h3]Witch's servant[/h3] Witch's servant has been added. You can make requests with gold. But if you attack it...
[/list]
[h1]Improvements:[/h1]
[list]
[*] [h3]Armor Destruction Related Improvements[/h3] When armor is destroyed, only upper body equipment is now destroyed. Other equipment, apart from the destroyed upper body gear, can be replaced at any time. The emphasis on HP has been increased.
[*] [h3]Damage Calculation Formula Modification[/h3] The damage calculation formula has been changed to address combat balance issues identified in the 1st test. Extreme damage output issues have been resolved.
[*] [h3]30 New Weapons added[/h3] 30 new weapons have been added for greater variety.
[*] [h3]Increase in Weapons and Equipment Options[/h3] For more diverse equipment, the number of options for equipment has been increased from 4 to 6.
[*] [h3]Improvement to Baran’s Grappling Hook Attack[/h3] The popular skill had issues properly pulling enemies if slightly caught. The pulling method has been improved to smoothly pull enemies.
[*] [h3]Warning Message when Entering Dungeon with Items[/h3] To prevent accidentally bringing items, if there are a certain number of items in the inventory or in the safe deposit box, a warning message will be displayed when entering the dungeon.
[*] [h3]Canceling Skill or Bow Attack[/h3] Right-clicking during a bow attack or skill casting allows cancellation.
[*] [h3]Interaction with Doors[/h3] Previously, the interaction had to be done where the door closed. Now, proper interaction with door objects is possible, reducing confusion.
[*] [h3]Ranged Attacks Possible through Iron Bars[/h3] While ranged attacks through iron bars were supported in the past, the hitbox was ambiguous. The modeling of iron bars has been modified to clearly create a space where attacks can be made.
[*] [h3]Alert when Being the Last Person in the Dungeon[/h3] An alert is displayed when you become the last party or person in the dungeon.
[*] [h3]Mission Item Acquisition for All Party Members Simultaneously[/h3] When completing a mission, everyone can now acquire the item instead of just one person. We will monitor gamers' reactions during this test.
[*] [h3]Added basic storage capacity increase and expansion feature[/h3] You can now expand your storage using gold.
[*] [h3]Fixed an issue where character corpses disappeared[/h3]  Addressed the problem of defeated characters from other players not disappearing.
[/list]
